title: Managed Database disk usage is high
description: Notifies when a Managed Database node uses more than 85% of its disk.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] Database {{entity_label.name}} disk usage is high
definition.message:
Disk usage on database `{{entity_label.name}}` ({{node_type.name}}) is {{value}}%.

Resize the database cluster or remove unused data before it runs out of space.
